# Menerick's Security Ledger - Full Text Archive

> **About this archive**
> This is the full text of securesql.info, the research site of John Menerick (W8MEJ),
> an independent Principal Security Engineer based in Castro Valley, CA, with 18+ years in information security.
> His work focuses on AI and agent security, cloud detection and response, zero-trust architecture,
> zero-knowledge systems, and complex systems SOC design.
> CV: https://cv.securesql.info · Contact: john.menerick@owasp.org · LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/w8mej
> Also: GitHub https://github.com/w8mej · X https://x.com/w8mej · YouTube https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCUfaf6mQgh_cX6V-SaAww1w
> · Twitch https://www.twitch.tv/w8mej · Zero Noise Collective podcast https://open.spotify.com/show/4BZNfTMlJ5iCD9bUW13sNq
> Content is original research by John Menerick unless noted, licensed CC BY 4.0; please attribute and link to the source URL.
